title: Feature Request - Additional options for "Number icon in notification area" feature
body:
I'm going to take a look at the number icon code to see if I can implement some of this sometime soon, but I think these might be nice as user-toggleable options:

* Include the trend arrow in the icon, either fully replacing the number icon or supplementing it.
* Using either a foreground or a background color on the notification to highlight below/in/above the target bg range (e.x., yellow/red if high/low)

This might be comically stupid to even attempt because the notification area is so small, but I do a combination of these two things for desktop bg notifications and it's pretty convenient. Maybe you could put the number on the right side of the unexpanded notification, where a minified version of the graph currently appears?
